en.headline: Man arrested after mother injured in knife attack at Chai Wan estate
en.dek: Police said a 31-year-old man called officers on Thursday evening after attacking his 63-year-old mother with two cleavers at Hing Wah Estate; she was taken to hospital conscious.
body: A 31-year-old local man was arrested on Thursday evening after police said he attacked his 63-year-old mother with knives inside their flat at Cheuk Wah House in Hing Wah Estate, Chai Wan.

Officers received a report from the man around 6 pm in which he said he had used a knife on his mother. At the scene they found two cleavers measuring about 25 cm and 27 cm. The woman sustained wounds to her head, neck, face, arms and back; she was conscious when taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.

Police said preliminary inquiries indicated the pair had argued over a matter involving money. The man was arrested on suspicion of wounding and the case is being handled by the Eastern District Crime Unit. No previous domestic disputes were recorded at the address, according to officers.
The man and his mother, along with his father and elder brother, had lived at the flat for more than 20 years.

zh.headline: 柴灣興華邨男子持刀襲母被捕 傷者清醒送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，31歲男子周四傍晚報案，稱在興華邨卓華樓住所用兩把菜刀襲擊63歲母親；母親多處受傷但清醒，送東區醫院治理。
body: 一名31歲本地男子周四傍晚被警方拘捕，涉嫌在柴灣興華（一）邨卓華樓住所內用刀襲擊其63歲母親。
警方接獲該男子約下午6時報案，指自己曾用刀襲擊母親。現場檢獲兩把分別長約25厘米及27厘米的菜刀。母親頭部、頸部、面部、手臂及背部有傷，清醒被送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院。
警方初步調查顯示，兩人曾因金錢問題爭執。男子涉嫌傷人被捕，案件由東區重案組跟進。警方指涉事單位過往無家庭糾紛紀錄。
該男子與父母及兄長同住該單位超過20年。
